classification_effect.statement: the registered intake / gas-path designs miss the A4 necessary condition in every surface scenario at the listed cells: DESIGN_VARIABLE_LIMIT, never PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING; the only non-closure route by a registered spacecraft-envelope bound is A4 CA4 on a FROZEN area limit (A4-REG-01 OPEN)

harness_classification.note: the harness result after A5; the architecture classification is the coordinator's (M2)

A_eff_m2.definition: aperture area A of the F1 candidate (A4 effective collection area; AREA_EFF_EQUALS_APERTURE_NO_SPACECRAFT_GEOMETRY_REGISTERED)

mdot_cap_kg_s.definition: F1 IF-A1 forward-transmitted flow (O + N2 + O2; direct TPMC, theta 0) x A, as the admitted F7 chain reads it

A_cap_eq_m2.definition: mdot_cap / Phi_max: the ideal-collector area capturing the same flow

mdot_del_kg_s.definition: delivered flow after filter, compressor and plenum (admitted steady chain, one target P_set)

x_mole_O_N2_O2.definition: mole fractions of the delivered flow

A_req_m2.definition: A4 K-AREQ at P_avail (eta_cap = 1, Phi_max, q_max)

mdot_req_A9_35_kg_s.definition: A4 K-MDOT-REQ at P_avail (electric power only; the A9.35 carried-forward value)

mdot_req_in_kg_s.definition: A4 K-MDOT-REQ at P_avail + q_max A(d) (binding flow requirement of L-CAP / L-DEL)

k.definition: multiplier required / actual (L-AREA A_req/A_eff, L-CAP mdot_req,in/mdot_cap, L-DEL mdot_req,in/mdot_del); <= 1 passes; null = unbounded

k_fav / k_unfav.definition: best design multiplier in the most / least favorable surface scenario

verdict.definition: FAILS_IN_EVERY_SCENARIO | PASSES_IN_EVERY_SCENARIO | SCENARIO_DEPENDENT | NOT_ESTABLISHED_ROBUST_SET_EMPTY | NOT_EVALUATED (A5 sec. statewise)

labels.definition: PARAMETRIC_SENSITIVITY (F1 / F7 / F8 inputs); necessary conditions only; not a performance prediction

what_this_is_not: not a performance prediction: every requirement is the A4 conservation necessary condition at its favorable limit
not an area limit: A4-REG-01 stays OPEN; no maximum intake area is invented or frozen
not a selection or a flight mass-flow requirement (A9.13 S6.20, S6.21)
not the architecture classification (the coordinator states it in M2)
